subject: Invoice delivery preference and temporary email copies
messages:
From: Elena Morris <accounts-payable@brightlane.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice delivery method and onboarding copies

Hi Jordan,

Quick question as we prep for Redwood going live: BrightLane generally prefers invoices to land via our AP portal (Coupa) but during onboarding we need emailed PDF copies CC'd to accounts-payable@brightlane.com for the first two billing cycles. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) enroll our company in your portal and 2) send email copies for the first 2 invoices to AP while portal enrollment completes?

Also need to confirm where the PO should appear (invoice line or header) and whether you capture VAT ID on the invoice PDF. Our AP team expects PO 4217 for the initial subscription.

I've attached our AP profile for fields and contacts.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Accounts Payable Manager
BrightLane Health
attachments: brightlane-ap-profile.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <accounts-payable@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery method and onboarding copies

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the AP profile. Short answers: yes to both, with a small preference/ask on our side so we can keep your ledger clean.

Plan I recommend: we can enroll BrightLane in our portal and we will enable "email-copy" forwarding for the first two invoices to accounts-payable@brightlane.com. After that, the portal will be the primary channel. If you'd like a permanent email CC we can keep it, but standard practice is portal primary with email copies as a fallback.

PO placement: we can put the PO in the invoice header (preferred) and also include it on each invoice line for line-level matching if your AP system requires it. We'll default to header + PO line tag unless you request otherwise.

VAT: we will render the VAT ID on the invoice PDF and tag the invoice metadata for your portal so reconciliation is straightforward.

I've attached a sample invoice PDF (redacted) so you can confirm layout. Can you confirm:
- final AP email for copies (accounts-payable@brightlane.com ok?)
- confirm PO = 4217 for first invoice
- confirm VAT ID to render (reply with the ID if different from what you attached)

Once you confirm I'll kick off the portal invite and temporarily enable email copies. Kimberly (cc) — can you confirm the portal template we use for BrightLane and whether we should lock email copy for 2 cycles or a date range?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
attachments: sample-invoice-redwood-202608.pdf (pdf)

Thanks, Jordan — accounts-payable@brightlane.com is correct for copies. Confirming PO 4217 should appear on header and invoice lines is fine. VAT ID is FR123456789.

We prefer that you send the portal invite and enable the two-email-copy window (first two invoice cycles). After the second invoice, BrightLane will switch to portal-only. Please include the remit-to bank details and the invoice number prefix (we need an easily searchable prefix for our internal matching).

Attached is the AP profile with the PO mapping and contact phone if you need to escalate during enrollment.

Best,
Elena
